title: feat(nsint): nnseed B3 interval census is 9 space, 3 null, 108 time
science: Two-record interval census: N_space=9, N_null=3, N_time=108 on the same 120 formed nonzero sites. The nine spacelike sites all have s^2=-1 and are the second seed plus its perpendicular descendants. The runner's own control records the 1-seed split as {space:0, null:4, time:116}.
